purpose: Reusable queue blueprints for future reviewer workflows.

queue_blueprints.name: source_inventory_review
queue_blueprints.purpose: Reviewer verifies carrier/row/label observations before page shell use.

queue_blueprints.name: payload_custody_review
queue_blueprints.purpose: Reviewer verifies capture, fixity, hash sidecars, redirects, and content-type.

queue_blueprints.name: bounded_summary_review
queue_blueprints.purpose: Reviewer checks summary against source and anti-collapse wording tests.

queue_blueprints.name: evidence_atom_review
queue_blueprints.purpose: Reviewer verifies atom type, source voice, modality, locator, and scope.

queue_blueprints.name: claim_candidate_review
queue_blueprints.purpose: Reviewer checks required atoms, defeaters, privacy, due-process, and rollback dependencies.

queue_blueprints.name: agency_identity_review
queue_blueprints.purpose: Reviewer checks parent/subunit, aliases, external IDs, jurisdiction, denominator freshness.

queue_blueprints.name: person_identity_review
queue_blueprints.purpose: Reviewer blocks name-only merges and requires identifiers/negative-match checks.

queue_blueprints.name: incident_identity_review
queue_blueprints.purpose: Reviewer checks duplicate/split risks, civilian privacy, location/time precision.

queue_blueprints.name: lawsuit_settlement_review
queue_blueprints.purpose: Reviewer separates filing, allegation, disposition, settlement, amount, and admission scope.

queue_blueprints.name: brady_giglio_review
queue_blueprints.purpose: Reviewer checks legal basis, scope, secrecy, currentness, and defense-use risk.

queue_blueprints.name: public_display_review
queue_blueprints.purpose: Reviewer checks display necessity, minimization, caveats, corrections, role/access, and export risks.

queue_blueprints.name: correction_rollback_review
queue_blueprints.purpose: Reviewer routes corrections, appeals, reversals, takedowns, unmerges, and source drift.
